(āḥ)༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khrid 'chad tshul sa chen thugs thig bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/rje ba

tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khrid 'chad tshul sa chen thugs thig bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid 'chad pa'i skabs su nyer mkho 'ga' zhig brjod na/ slob ma bde mchog lū nag gam/ kye rdor gyi dbang bskur thob pa la/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis sogs dus dge bar mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs byed/ de'i yig cha'ang tshar chen rin po che'i mdzad pa'i rgyun khyer 'di dang*/ sgrub mchod kyi yig cha gnyis na gnad khyad par can yod pas 'di thogs nas nges par byed thub na legs shing*/ dbang bshad sogs cha lag rnams ni lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa gzhan nas kha bskang chog bla ma gong ma gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge rnams na tshar chen lta bu'i gnad de yod med sna tshogs 'dug ngag dbang chos grags kyi'ang byin rlabs yi ge zhig yod snyam pa/ khong yang mkhas grub gzhan las gnad 'ga' 'dril ba zhig yin/ gang ltar dbang byin rlabs thob pa'i slob ma rnams la khrid 'chad pa'i tshe/ gnas dben par stegs khebs ldan 'bru bkram la/ byung na mkha' spyod ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor zlum po'i bar du dur khrod bdag po'i gtor ma/ bsdu na zlum gtor gcig gang ltar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bshams la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug slob dpon gyi mdun du 'thor nas ḍā ma ru rdor dril nang mchod rnams bshams/ las kyi rdo rje'i drung maṇ+ḍal 'bru dri bzang gi chu rnams la slob ma tshogs gong slob dpon gyis mkha' spyod ma'i sgom bzlas dang*/ khrid gang 'chad pa de bsgoms la bkra shis kyi bar bya/ slob ma rnams kyis phyag dang yon phul rigs dang yon tan rgan pa dang*/ bslab pa sogs kyis gral rim la 'khod grub pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar la/

bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ dpon slob kun gyis 'ur 'don byas la he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig brjod/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma bdag ni sogs bshags sdom gyi tshig gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod la/ slob dpon nam gzhan gang rung gis bskul la/ brgyud 'debs lam rim gnad bskul rnams tshar chen gyis mdzad pa bzhin bya/ byung na brgyud 'debs la tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung gdangs yod pa bzhin gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi phyag len la'ang mdzad pas de bzhin bya/ lam rim tshugs pa dang las kyi rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal gyi 'bru bkye bsdu bya/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma gang gi mchod rdzas ma bcas bgyid skabs/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ tshar chen rin po che'i sgrub thabs kyi gsham nas 'byung ba ltar mkha' spyod mar gtor ma phul/ yang gong bzhin byin rlabs la dur khrod bdag po'i gtor sngags lan gsum phyi nang gi mchod pa phrin bcol/ yang gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams byas pa'i mthar/ lag pa rgyab sbyar mtheb srin gyis se gol dang*/ badz+ra muḥ 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma sogs brjod la/ zhwa yod na gyon lus kyi 'dug stangs drang por gnas pas/ zang zing med pa'i snying rje dang 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi blo yi dam gyi nga rgyal rnams gsal btab nas 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang rin po che de ci nas kyang thob nges par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/

chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'ang lus kyi 'dug stangs drang por gnas pa dang*/ sems kyi dmigs pa gnas khang 'di nyid kyang tha mal gyi snang ba tsam ma yin par dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du da lta chos ston mkhan gyi slob dpon yang tha mal gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu ma yin par/ seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal nas chos kyi sgra dbyangs grags stong skye ba med pa'i ngang du lhang lhang sgrogs pa srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sel bar byed pa dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyang thun mtshams kyi lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin pa'i ngang nas gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang nas yengs med kyi tshul du gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ 'dir dus gsum gyi zhes pa nas nyams su len par byed pa la/ zhes pa'i bar mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi khrid yig bzhin la/ spros pa la dga' na chos 'byung kyang zin thun du gnang ba'i phyag srol yod pas de ltar byed na/ de la spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyis/ zhes sogs kyi gleng gleng nas/ theg dman las theg chen khyad par 'phags tshul/ de la mdo sngags gnyis las/ sngags khyad par 'phags tshul/ de la slob dpon so so'i bzhed pas rgyud sde'i dbye sgo du ma yod kyang 'dir rgyud sde sgo drug tu bzhed tshul/ de'i rnam bzhag de'i 'thad pa/ de las 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam srol byung tshul/ de las rnal 'byor gsang mtha' khyad par 'phags tshul/ de la lū nag dril gsum bzhugs pa'i yang snying rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin tshul/

de la spyir phag mo'i rnam gzhag dang*/ bye brag nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor ngos bzung nas ring brgyud nye brgyud kyi rnam thar dang bcas pa 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed dang*/ ngor chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bskyed rim rnam bshad kyi dbu sogs nas bsdus la/ bla ma so so'i rnam thar nas kha bskang te rgyas bsdus ci rigs khrid nyi ma du byed la phral nas gnang srol 'dug cing*/ de dag gi sbrel mtshams gcig la gcig mtshon na/ nyin dang por theg chen khyad par 'phags tshul nas bzung rgyud sde sgo drug ngos 'dzin par lta bu gtong na ji srid mdo bya zhes sogs kyi lung sbyor dang*/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud zhes sogs nas/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dang drug bzhugs pa las/ 'dir gsang mtha'i snying khu rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam nyams su len par byed pa la/ gang gis sgrub pa'i zhes sogs khrid yig dang sbrel te song nas/ sang de kha sang bshad pa rnams mdor bsdus su byas nas sgo drug gi bshad pa rgyas pa nas bzung*/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor las rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsung tshul bar lta bu gtang nas/ de ltar gsungs pa'i rgyud sde'i snying khu rje btsun rdo rje zhes sogs gong bzhin/ deng sang*/ bde mchog gi lam srol byung tshul phag mo'i chos skor gyi rnam gzhag dang bcas pa rgyas par btang nas/ bla brgyud kyi rnam thar tshugs tsam byas la/ de lta bu'i grub pa'i slob dpon chen po de nyid nas bzung bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las 'ong pa'i rje btsun rdo rje zhes sogs gong bzhin la/ 'khrid yig nang gi rgyas pa de min pa'i mdor bsdus shig gtong*/ des mtshon pa'i 'og ma thams cad la shes par bya'o// yang chos 'byung mi gtong na khrid yig nang bzhin yin/

khrid kyi dmigs thun ni/ rje mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig gi sgo lcags gong sa lnga pa'i mthong grol lde mig gis phye bas mi shes pa ci yang med/ drin chen brag rtsa ba chen po ni/ mthong grol lde mig tu gsungs pa'i bsdus don tshigs bcad ma de yang nyin re bzhin gsungs pas/ zhu mi rnams la sa bcad nges pa'i khyad chen por yong bar 'dug bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la ni med pas gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang chen po ni bsdus don tshigs bcad ma de mi gsung*/ 'di gnyis gang byed rang 'dam ka yin/ mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig dang*/ mthong grol lde mig gnyis ra sprad nas las dang po pa rnams kyis rtogs sla ba'i phyir brjod na nub dang po mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig gi 'dir dus gsum nas brgya stong ngam gsum nges par brjod do bar/ slar yang thugs la nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa nyams su len pa la gang zag rab 'bring gsum mam/ shin tu tha ma skye ba brgyud nas/ zhes pa nas/ gsum nges par brjod do bar/ slar yang thugs la nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar nas/ zhes sogs bshad ma thag pa bzhin lan gcig bskyar la/ gsum nges par brjod pas sngon nas nyams len byed bzhin pa yin na/ tshad med kyi rnal 'byor sogs shar gyis nyams su blangs la smon lam bkra shis kyi bar bya/ da nas bzung nyams len byed pa yin na/ skyabs sems kyi rjes su de lta bu las byung ba'i dge ba rnams gzhan don du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab nas thun las ldang ba dang*/ thun mtshams thams cad du yang sgo gsum dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' dgos pas do nub kyi thugs dam dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam la mdzad par zhu/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob mas phyag phul nas rang gnas su phyin/ de nas bzung khrid ma grol bar la thun bzhi chag med byed/ 'di pa'i lugs la mthong grol lde mig tu gsungs pa ltar byin rlabs thob nas rgyun khyer dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i dam bca' chags med du bzla dgos pas/ gong du rnam gzhag gnyis bshad pa de ni spyir btang tsam mo/ ༈ /nub gnyis pa la 'dir dus gsum zhes pa nas gsum brjod do bar/ kha sang bzhin tshar gcig bskyar la/ da do nub kyi nyams len gyi rim pa la'ang sgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ dpyad don dmigs par bsgril nas nyams su len pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la/ bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ zhes pa nas sa chen gyi gzhung du 'byung ba'i de bzhin bya/ zhes pa'i bar/ gnyis pa bcad don dmigs par dril nas nyams su len pa la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ ma rgyud spyi dang 'dra bas de la lha bsgoms/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba dang gsum/ zhes sogs/ bde kye'i bskyed rim rnam bshad sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin bshad la/ gsung sgros yin gsung bar/ slar yang thugs nges par bya ba'i phyir da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ do nub nas brtsams te khyed rang rnams rang rang gi gnas mal rnams su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas bzhugs/ dbugs rlung rngam pa rang zhir ma song gi bar la cung zad tsam ngal gsos/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de la bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor zhes sogs/ gsung sgros yin gsung bar/ slar yang thugs zhes sogs tshar gcig bskyar la mjug sdud tshul gong bzhin la spyir btang ltar rdor sems bsgoms bzlas kyi rjes su bsngo smon yin no/ ༈ /nub gsum par dang po'i de yam tsam gcig bshad/ gnyis pa'i de tshang ma tshar gcig bshad nas/

da do nub kyi zhes sogs nas gnyis yod pa las bar/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni zhes pa nas/ ye shes tshogs bsog 'dis lam du byed pa'o gsung bar/ gnyis pa bcad don dmigs par bsgril nas nyams su len pa la/ bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gnas tshad bzhag go bar/ zhal shes gsum la yi ge zur na yod pa bzhin las zhal shes dang po gnyis bshad/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba de thun gcig las bsgom mi dgos/ slar yang sogs gong bzhin la/ da ci'i de lan gnyis bskyar/ mjug bsdu tshul yang rigs 'gre sbyar nas dmigs gsal bsgyur bas 'thus/ de bzhin 'og ma thams cad la 'dra ste/ dmigs pa sngon rim rnams rkang grangs yam me bar re bshad/ kha sang bshad pa de tshang 'grigs te bshad pa'i rjes su/ do nub kyi de sbrel ba dang*/ bshad ma thag pa de lan gnyis bshad pas gsum/ sang tshar gcig bshad pa de la bzhi bshad ces tshar lugs gyi phyag len la mdzad/ ngor pa rnams gsung ngag sogs 'chad pa'i skabs su de ring gnyis dang*/ sang gcig gsungs pas gsum bshad mdzad/ rdzong gong gnyis ni bshad pa'i spros pa ci yang ma mdzad par/ khrid yig dmar bsdus de thun bcad ngag slob tu mdzad nas sgom du 'jug go /zhes pa ni 'phros don no/ ༈ /nub bzhi par gnyis yod pa las/ bar gong bzhin la/ dang po la drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni zhes pa nas/ rtogs pa mas char zhes bya ba yin la bar/ gnyis pa bcad don dmigs pa bsgril nas nyams su len pa ni/ gnas tshad gzhag pa'i ngang las/ rang sems a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar zhes sogs mngon rtogs rgyun khyer zhar byung rdzogs rim dang bcas pa bshad pa nas rtsa sngags oṃ gsum ma dam bca' bzhin chag med du bzlas pas/ re zhig nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su 'dzin par bshad pa ni gang zag rab bzlas bsgom la brten mkha' spyod sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin pas khyed rang rnams kyang sgom bzlas chag med nyams su len pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin/

bcad don dngos byed pa can gyi bskyed rim la sems 'dzin gyi rim pa rnams 'byung bas/ de la nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa/ rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa/ bye brag la sems 'dzin pa/ lus dkyil la sems 'dzin pa dang bzhi yod pa las/ dang po nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa ni/ zhar byung rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i rjes su nga tha mal pa nam yang ma yin skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs 'bras dus bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de dngos yin snyam du nga rgyal bskyed la hril gyis bsgrim tha mal gyi snang ba 'gags pa tsam byung na/ a 'thas mi bya bar mdun gyi dngos po gang rung zhig gi steng du sems spos la lhod kyis bzhag yang 'og 'gyu skyes na nga rgyal la hril gyis bsgrim/ de ltar byas kyang rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal mi 'char bar tha mal gyi rtog pa kho na shar kyang u tshug mi bya bar rim gyis bslab ste/ de ltar thun chung la grangs mang ba'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs pa'i mthar thun mong ba'i bsam mi khyab sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung bzhin rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya dgos pas/ slar yang thugs sogs gong bzhin no/ ༈ /nub lnga par sgro 'dogs gcod par de yang ye shes tshogs bsag gi nas 'od phung du bsgom pa'o// bcad don nyams len la/ de ltar nga rgyal la sems bzung tshar ba'i rjes su/ gnyis pa rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa ni/ 'o na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin na de'i rnam pa ji lta bu zhe na/ de'ang sku mdog nas spyi la sems 'dzin par byed bar/ hril gyis sgrim/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog skyes na gzhan la spo ba sogs gong bzhin byas la/ gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung zhing bsgom pa 'di gong 'og kun tu gces so// mjug sdud tshul sogs gong bzhin no// drug pa sgro 'dogs gcod pa gzhi bsgyur ba ni nas bkal ba'i tshul gyis bsnams pa bar/

bcad don rnam pa spyi la sems bzung tshar nas/ de nas gsum pa bye brag la sems 'dzin pa ni spyan dbu ma nas langs pa lta bu la sems 'dzin par byed bar/ bdun pa sgro 'dogs gcod pa kun tu 'dzin pa'i gnas rnam pa can bar gzhi bsgyur ba ni nas rnam pa can bar/ bcad don de nas rim bzhin spyan nas dmar zhing legs pa bar/ brgyad par sgro 'dogs gcad pa spyi bor rigs kyi nas byin rlabs byed pa yin bar/ bcad don mgul pa nas khrong zhing rgyas pa bar/ dgu pa sgro 'dogs bcad pa bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i nas spro na kye rdor bzhin bya bar/ bcad don phyag g.yas nas gsol ba bar/ bcu pa sgro 'dogs bcad pa/ de nas lag pa nas gnyis rnams su sgom pa'o bar/ bcad don rked pa nas rgyan med pa la sems 'dzin par byed bar/ pho nya gsum bsre 'di'i skabs su slob ma snod ldan la lus dkyil ston par 'dod na/ yig chung bzhin zur du gsum las mang ba la mi ston no/ ༈ /bcu gcig par sgro 'dogs bcad pa dgu pa bzlas pa'i nas 'bad par bya'o gsung bar/ bcad don de nas dpral ba nas mgul bar mgul rgyan bar/ ༈ /bcu gnyis par sgro 'dogs bcad pa zhar byung rdzogs rim nas 'jog par byed bar/ bcad don dpung pa gnyis nas nyams su len par byed la bar/ ༈ /bcu gsum par sgro 'dogs bcad pa bcu pa bsam mi khyab nas byed pa yin gsung bar/ bcad don lus dkyil bshad tshar ba rnams la lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i spyan dbus mar sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu bzhi par sgro 'dogs bcad pa bcu gcig par spyod lam nas/ ma yengs par bya gsung bar/ bcad don lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i spyan gnyis dang zhal la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bco lnga par sgro 'dogs bcad pa gnyis pa yan lag nas nyams su len par byed bar/ bcad don gtso mo'i mgul nas zhabs kyi bar la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu drug par sgro 'dogs bcad pa bzhi pa tshes bcu nas rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o bar/

bcad don gtso mo'i rgyan cha lugs la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu bdun par sgro 'dogs bcad pa de ltar gang zag nas dbang po rab tu gyur pa'o bar/ bcad don lus dkyil 'khor gyi lha so drug gi spyan dbu mar sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bco brgyad par sgro 'dogs bcad pa gal te de ltar ma gyur kyang nas byed pa yin gsung bar/ bcad don 'khor so drug gi spyan gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /bcu dgu par sgro 'dogs bcad pa gal te de ltar nas gal che gsungs so bar/ 'dir 'pho dmigs dngos gzhi mi ston par snod ldan re gnyis la 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i mjug tu yab yum gang rung gi 'pho dmigs mdzad nas gcig slar skabs su gang babs la gnang*/ bcad don 'khor so drug rgyan can la sems 'dzin/ ༈ /nyi shu pa nas bzung rdzogs rim tshugs pas/ nyi shu par gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni nas rnal 'byor ro bar/ slar yang sogs nas 'jug par bya ste bar gong bzhin la/ bskyed rim sems 'dzin dang bcas pa bsgom la rdzogs rim zab mo 'di nyams su blangs te/ de yang chags can pho nya'i lam nas rnal 'byor bar/ slar yang sogs so/ ༈ /nyer gcig par gnyis pa rlung nas sel bar 'gyur gsung bar/ ༈ /nyer gnyis par gnyis pa ni/ yang smin mtshams nas 'char ba zhig 'ong la bar/ nyer gsum par gong du bshad pa bzhin snod ldan la 'pho dmigs/ ༈ /nyer bzhi par zhal shes gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas gsum las mang bar mi ston zhing de'ang re re nas ston/ ༈ /nub nyer lnga par de nas thog mar nas tshul bzhin du bya'o gsung bar lan gsum bskyar pa'i rjes su/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo cha tshang du thob pa yin pas bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ zhes dang*/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod sogs spyi 'gre bzhin/

deng nas sogs/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i snying khu grub mchog gi slob dpon dpal nā ro ta pa la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su gnang ba nas bzung*/ snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha ma dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i nye lam dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid bka' zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas nyams su len pa dang*/ snod min la bab 'chol du mi ston zhing*/ snod ldan la bla ma'i phyag len bzhin rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du ston pa sogs rang gzhan gyi don mtha' yas par mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs chos bsngo gang shes bya'o// de yang bla ma gong ma phal cher phyag len la chos bsngor bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ bshad nyan gyi bsngo ba mdo nas gsungs pa chos 'byung rnams su 'byung ba'i// theg mchog dam chos rin chen nas/ mdzod du 'gyur bar mdzad/ de la'ang slob dpon gyis bshad 'di la zhes dang slob mas nyan 'di la zhes tshig bsgyur dgos so// de ltar khrid bcad pa'i tshul 'di ni rje mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo dang*/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mthong grol lde mig sor bzhag yin la/ thun mong ba dang bsdus la dga' na zhal shes gsum dang*/ lus dkyil gyi rdzogs rim rgyas pa 'pho ba rnams bzhag nas rnal 'byor bcu gcig zhar byung rdzogs rim dang bcas pas cho ga 'bring du byed na zhal shes gsum lus dkyil 'pho ba rnams bzhag nas bskyed rdzogs gnyis bstan pas chog shin tu rgyas pa byed na gong du bshad pa ltar sngon 'gro chos 'byung*/ dngos gzhir 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim rnam bshad rgyas pa sbyar/

mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig dang mthong grol lde'u mig bzhin rdzogs pas chos nyid dngos bstan gyi byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i dbu ma'i khrid rgyas pa yar klung pa dang mkhyen brtse'i khrid yig bzhin bstan pas sgro 'dogs chod cing phyag len shin tu rgyas par 'gyur ro// sa skya par phyag len thams cad mthun par khrid ma theb kyi bar la bskyed rim rnam bshad dang khrid dpe'i lung mdzad srol med cing*/ slob ma rnams nas kyang lkog tu blta mi nyan la/ gal te bltas na dam nyams gsang ba'i dgra bo byin rlabs mi 'jug pa yin no zhes gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang nas yang yang gsung ba zhig yod pas gnad 'di yang snying dkyil du 'chang zhing*/ ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig dngos grub myur 'gug la'ang phan thogs pa yod do// zhes rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid 'chad tshul gyis zin bris 'di yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang dang*/ brag rtsa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gnyis kyi sku drin las lugs 'di skor la skal ba bzang por skyes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gdan sa chen po'i zur chad rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams dang rigs kyi bu sogs slad nas 'byon 'gyur gdung rabs rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i me 'bar gtsug lag khang gi yang steng bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che sogs bla ma gong ma du ma'i grub gnyis mngon du mdzad pa'i gnas 'phags pa phug tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis rgyal mtshan no// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
